title: Navajo skinwalker lore matches ranch activity

tellings.quote: Cuz I was doing a little Googling and it was like talking about luminous objects,

plain: The old Navajo stories of skinwalkers, shape-shifting figures from Navajo tradition, talk about glowing objects. Those are much like what people report at Skinwalker Ranch, a property named after the legend and known for strange happenings. Michels says he found this himself while doing a little Googling, and raises it as a hint that the activity at the ranch may be very old.
